train_VERTrainer: run the VERTrainer train method to start distributed VER reinforcement learning training with environment and inference workers
init_train_VERTrainer: initialize the VERTrainer by spawning environment workers, inference workers, report worker, and preemption decider processes
update_agent_VERTrainer: update the agent policy by computing returns with GAE and performing a gradient update step on the learning rollouts
create_agent_VERTrainer: create an agent using the baseline registry with the configured agent type, environment spec, and optional resume state
save_resume_state_VERTrainer: save the training resume state including checkpoint count, steps done, and report worker state for preemption recovery
